items.summary: Own the architecture and delivery of an enterprise e-invoicing compliance platform and core ERP modules, from requirements through production onboarding.
highlights: Planned, architected and built an enterprise e-invoicing compliance platform that keeps businesses aligned with NRS/FIRS requirements with minimal manual intervention, onboarding 5+ enterprise clients and integrating each one's ERP regardless of the underlying system.

Built a RAG-powered invoice transformation service that pulls invoices from Sage and QuickBooks, converts them to FIRS-compliant schemas, validates payloads, and maps FIRS responses back to ERP formats using LLM-based field mapping and anomaly detection.
Integrated legacy Sage X3 through a self-hosted Activepieces automation layer, connecting on-premise infrastructure to the cloud platform without major changes to the legacy system.

Developed microservices integrating directly with FIRS/NRS endpoints for taxpayer authentication, validation, signing, confirmation, download, update, exchange and reporting, designed around asynchronous event-driven messaging to scale across high invoice volumes.

On Converge 2.0 ERP, re-engineered platform-wide RBAC from an XLS-driven process populated via Kafka into a code-owned, manifest-driven permission system that auto-registers permissions for new modules.
Built the Leave Management and Expense Management backends end to end: request APIs, leave types, balances, approvals, cash advances, cash retirement and workflow validation.

Engineered an LLM-powered assessment generator producing multiple-choice, true/false and scenario-based questions as standardised JSON for i-Academy, with scoring logic, difficulty ranking and version-controlled prompt templates.
Served as primary technical point of contact through client demos and post-onboarding support, closing 5+ enterprise accounts.

highlights: WallX Paycode (Jan–May 2025): developed secure payment APIs and integrated finance gateways, improved database performance, and implemented PCI-aligned security practices.
SEEVEES_ai (Aug 2024–Jan 2025): built an NLP résumé parser with spaCy and PDFMiner, plus JWT authentication, automated reminders and applicant pipelines.
Ruumready Hotel Management (May–Aug 2024): built room management, wallet and booking APIs, with Celery and Redis handling asynchronous notifications and background jobs.
AMARAE e-commerce (Jan–Aug 2023): developed high-performance APIs for products, payments and order processing.
